hooks.command: cd /home/user/hacs && [ -f .venv/bin/activate ] && source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null || true; python3 -c "import pct; print('[remote-control] HACS v' + pct.__version__ + ' pronto')" 2>/dev/null || echo '[remote-control] ambiente pronto'

INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -q 'pct/__init__\.py' && { VER=$(grep -oP '(?<=__version__ = ")[\d.]+' "$FILEPATH"); [ -n "$VER" ] && sed -i "s/^#  version: .*/#  version: $VER/" railway.toml && echo "[hook] railway.toml aggiornato a v$VER"; } || true
